story: For the past couple of years, I'd been lovingly using Arc Browser. I loved its sidebar, the spaces, the way tabs got out of the way. When they announced its shutdown, I was devastated, and I knew I wanted a browser that I could depend on in the long term — built with productivity, convenience, and privacy in mind.

So I'm rewriting it clean-room: native SwiftUI and AppKit on WKWebView, with the same spaces, three-tier sidebar, one-click import from my own Arc data, tab hibernation, and a built-in ad blocker. No code from Arc, no Arc assets, no Arc trademarks. The look and feel, rebuilt.
It's in development now, and when it's ready it will be live at alpbrowser.app!
tagline: Say hello to Alp. (not me, the browser)
